title: Welcome, safety & baseline
content:
Meet the group, check equipment, review lift safety and record starting skills.

Planning reference: Season Plan 2022-23, page 5. Adapted draft for current-season review; not an approved all-program teaching standard.

title: Edging & stopping
content:
Plan suitable terrain and observe controlled stops. Record what each learner demonstrated.

Planning reference: Season Plan 2022-23, page 6. Adapted draft for current-season review; not an approved all-program teaching standard.

title: Balance & movement
content:
Use age-appropriate games, build confidence and record an observable movement outcome.

Planning reference: Season Plan 2022-23, page 7. Adapted draft for current-season review; not an approved all-program teaching standard.

title: Mid-season review
content:
Review evidence together, identify gaps and prepare a handoff note for each learner.

Planning reference: Season Plan 2022-23, page 8. Adapted draft for current-season review; not an approved all-program teaching standard.

title: Pressure & varied terrain
content:
Adapt to learner readiness and conditions. Park content requires supervisor review and staff training.

Planning reference: Season Plan 2022-23, page 9. Adapted draft for current-season review; not an approved all-program teaching standard.

title: Turn shape & application
content:
Review speed control and apply existing skills to suitable terrain; complete six-week group summaries.

Planning reference: Season Plan 2022-23, page 10. Adapted draft for current-season review; not an approved all-program teaching standard.

title: Evidence & parent reports
content:
Use accumulated observations to prepare accurate reports. Agree next steps with the supervisor.

Planning reference: Season Plan 2022-23, page 11. Adapted draft for current-season review; not an approved all-program teaching standard.

title: Celebrate & hand over
content:
Celebrate individual progress, issue approved reports and capture recommendations for next season.

Planning reference: Season Plan 2022-23, page 12. Adapted draft for current-season review; not an approved all-program teaching standard.
